title: Geography Around Us
text:
Geography is the study of the Earth. A mountain is very high land. A river is a long line of water that goes to the sea. There is a big lake near my house.

An island is land with water all around it. Many islands are in the sea. There is a forest with tall trees on the hill. In a desert, there is a lot of sand and very little water.

questions.text: What is a mountain, according to paragraph one?
options: a big area of salt water
land with water all around it

questions.text: What is in a desert, according to paragraph two?
options: a lot of sand and very little water
a big lake near a house

questions.text: Why might a person on an island need a boat to go to other places?
options: Because the island is surrounded by water
Because the island is covered by a forest
Because the island is a desert
Because the island has a big lake

questions.text: Where would it be hardest to find water?

vocabulary.definition: a very high area of land
a long line of water that flows to the sea
land with water all around it
a dry place with a lot of sand and very little water

paragraph_translations: Географія — це вивчення Землі. Гора — це дуже висока ділянка землі. Річка — це довга лінія води, яка тече до моря. Недалеко від мого дому є велике озеро.
Острів — це земля, навколо якої є вода. Багато островів є в морі. На пагорбі є ліс з високими деревами. У пустелі багато піску і дуже мало води.
